scope: state-based acceptance for the synthetic A02 cohort

residualRisks.statement: Committed state at a snapshot does not establish exact-request attribution, backend termination, drained work or future stability.
Two stable snapshots, elapsed time, expiry, revocation, hashes and local counters cannot prove all work drained.
Late creation/provisioning and cleanup/recreation races remain possible after UNKNOWN; conservative quarantine can leave fixtures pending review.
Owner adoption accepts an observed effect while its producer and future side effects remain uncertain; it supplies neither a provider transaction receipt nor cleanup authority.
Exact-ID observations cannot exclude unrelated/transient writes or unknown unlinked canonical orphans; suspected orphans need separate investigation.
Separate captures, provenance and private hashes do not supply an independent human or tamper-proof audit service when the owner also observes.
Auth/configuration drift, concurrent administrators, stale sessions, clock disagreement or incomplete visibility can undermine the baseline; stop on drift and retain unknowns.
Acceptance applies only to this Development synthetic cohort and implies no Production security claim, provisioning activation, grants or commercial-user acceptance.

approvalSource.statement: Explicit operator approval in this conversation, as reported by the operator in A02 Check 8; policy and documented residual risks only.
